name: Alex
role: fictional client: a small ceramics studio that sells through a Telegram channel
identity_rules: The client is called Alex. Never Sasha.
This package is synthetic: it describes nobody and exists so the installer has something to install.
audience_hypotheses: People who buy one gift-sized piece, not a set
Other makers who follow the process more than the product
discovery_questions: Where do your buyers find you today?
What did you post last week, and what did people answer?
What would one good month look like, in your own words?
how_to_work_with_them: Quote the client's own words before proposing anything.
forbidden: Prices the client did not state
Promises of sales, followers or reach

approved_cta.text: Write to the channel if a piece speaks to you.

content_plan.intent: Show the process, one piece at a time.

items.title: From clay to kiln in one minute
The piece that cracked
items.note: An honest failure, and what it taught.
